slug: 2025-12-01 Biometric Digital-ID in Africa - Ten Country Case Studies

systems.system: National register (Omang) access by the Botswana Police Service
systems.owner: Department of Civil and National Registration holds the register; technical support from the Department of Shared Digital Services
systems.tiers: The National Registration (Amendment) Act 1993 authorises the Botswana Police Service, among four bodies, to draw on Omang data; the document describes a legal authorisation, not a technical link

note: Passages file; the Botswana passages concern the Omang national identity system, digitised in 1999 with an automated fingerprint identification system that is the civil identity system's, not a police one. The police appear only as a body authorised to access the register. Nothing on station records. Passages on Egypt, Liberia and Namibia are other countries' and give nothing for BWA.
